sources.entry: Pixley Reader - Reader for Markdown specs, docs, and changelogs generated by AI tools. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Applacat/PixleyReader) [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758722045?platform=mac)

summary.one_liner: A native macOS app for browsing and reading the markdown files (specs, docs, changelogs) that AI coding tools generate in project folders.
summary.what_it_does: Pixley Reader gives a dedicated window for reading markdown without opening a code editor. It has a folder tree sidebar built on NSOutlineView for browsing large trees. It watches files on disk and shows a reload pill when a file changes, such as when an AI tool rewrites it. A Quick Switcher (Cmd+P) does fuzzy file search. Markdown is rendered with syntax highlighting across 7 theme families, each with light and dark variants. An optional on-device chat uses Apple Foundation Models to ask questions about the open document. Folders or files can be opened by dragging them onto the window.
use_cases: read markdown specs generated by AI tools
browse project docs without a code editor
view changelogs in a native Mac app
watch files that an AI coding tool keeps rewriting
quickly find a markdown file by name
ask questions about a document with on-device AI
notable: Built for markdown files that AI coding tools produce in project folders
On-device AI chat via Apple Foundation Models, with no cloud or API keys
Live file watching with a reload prompt when files change on disk
caveats: AI chat requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) and Apple Intelligence
Listed in the README as available on the Mac App Store, which may be a paid download; the README does not state pricing
